OpenTune {{APP_VERSION}} with the local control API - unofficial test build {{BUILD_LABEL}}
INSTALL (Windows 10 / 11, x64)

(中文：INSTALL.zh-CN.txt)

This is NOT an official OpenTune release. The only official channel is
{{OFFICIAL_RELEASES_URL}}. Read README-UNOFFICIAL.txt first.

The commands below are for Windows PowerShell. Replace <folder> with the folder
you extract the package to.


1. Install official OpenTune first
----------------------------------

- Install official OpenTune {{MIN_OFFICIAL_VERSION}} or later from
  {{OFFICIAL_RELEASES_URL}}
  for all users of the computer, in the default location
  (C:\Program Files\OpenTune).
- This package contains no model weights. This build uses the models of that
  installation (C:\Program Files\OpenTune\models). Without it, pitch detection,
  note generation and rendering do not work.


2. Check the download
---------------------

- Compare the SHA-256 of the zip with the value on the release page:

    Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 .\{{PACKAGE_NAME}}.zip

- Remove the "downloaded from the internet" mark from the zip before
  extracting it, so that Windows does not mark every extracted file:

    Unblock-File .\{{PACKAGE_NAME}}.zip


3. Extract
----------

- Extract the zip to a folder of your own outside "Program Files", for example
  %USERPROFILE%\Apps. Do not extract it into the official installation folder
  and do not replace any official files.
- Check every extracted file against SHA256SUMS (no output means all match):

    cd <folder>
    Get-Content .\SHA256SUMS | ForEach-Object {
      $hash, $name = $_ -split '  ', 2
      if ((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $name).Hash -ne $hash) { "MISMATCH: $name" }
    }


4. GPU acceleration: copy D3D12Core.dll once (optional)
-------------------------------------------------------

This package does not include the DirectX 12 Agility runtime. Copy it once
from your official installation. Without it, this build runs AI inference on
the CPU, which is slower.

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '<folder>\D3D12' | Out-Null
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath "$env:ProgramFiles\OpenTune\D3D12\D3D12Core.dll" -Destination '<folder>\D3D12\D3D12Core.dll'
    (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath '<folder>\D3D12\D3D12Core.dll').Hash

- The hash must be
  {{D3D12CORE_SHA256}}
  (DirectX 12 Agility SDK {{D3D12_AGILITY_VERSION}}, the version this build
  was made with). If it is different, delete the folder <folder>\D3D12 again;
  this build then runs on the CPU.
- Copy only D3D12Core.dll. Do not copy D3D12SDKLayers.dll (a debugging layer).
- If you use OpenTune MCP Server, its doctor command checks this copy and its
  hash.


5. Start
--------

- OpenTune-AI.cmd starts OpenTune with the local control API on. Use it when
  OpenTune MCP Server should operate OpenTune.
- OpenTune.exe starts OpenTune with the control API off.
- Windows SmartScreen: the files are not code-signed, so SmartScreen may show
  "Windows protected your PC". If the hashes in steps 2 and 3 matched, click
  "More info", then "Run anyway".
- Smart App Control (Windows 11): when it is on, it may block unsigned
  programs such as this one, and it offers no exception for a single program.
  This test build then cannot run on that computer. We do not recommend
  turning Smart App Control off just for this build.


6. Settings and logs are shared with official OpenTune
------------------------------------------------------

- This build uses the same settings and log files as official OpenTune (in
  your user profile, under %APPDATA%). Changes made in one appear in the other.
- While the control API is on, OpenTune writes a discovery file to
  %LOCALAPPDATA%\OpenTune\control\instances\ and deletes it on normal exit.


7. Uninstall
------------

- Close OpenTune.
- Delete <folder>.
- Delete %LOCALAPPDATA%\OpenTune\control\ (files of the control API).
- Do not delete %APPDATA%\OpenTune: official OpenTune uses it too.
